statement: The sharp maximum number of real smooth plane cubics through eight general real points and tangent to one general real line is four.
scope: Smooth irreducible degree-three plane curves through eight general real points and tangent to one general real line.
notes: The one-tangency maximum was recorded with Ronga’s §4 theorem in the original combined family result R_b5eb708827acbf846ca18418a250d99f86f0df7690f826b0f947c73d82874245. The separate two-tangency result is due to Bertrand. Here k denotes the number of tangent-line conditions.
